finding: Library, artist Search and alphabet pages consistently use AlbumArtists. A track-only artist lacking an AlbumArtist relation is not discoverable through this index. An artist with AlbumArtist relations on audio may already appear even without a MusicAlbum item; missing/zero album counts do not establish track-only status.

provider_evidence.observed: GetArtists lacks a standalone/primary-credit predicate. Type filters constrain related items, not performer role. Counts are conditionally copied into artist DTOs.

GetArtists and GetAlbumArtists select Artist and AlbumArtist relations respectively. ContributingArtistIds tests Artist membership absent AlbumArtist membership on an item; it needs known IDs and includes featured-only credits.
artistIds, albumArtistIds and contributingArtistIds filter known identities; they do not discover standalone primary artists as a bounded classification query.

minimum_runtime_change: None until a trustworthy bounded provider distinction or owner-approved narrower policy exists. Do not swap to Artists, infer eligibility from nil/zero counts, parse display names, scan the entire catalog, or fan out per artist.
standalone_definition_gap: A provider identity appearing only in Artist relations can denote either a meaningful standalone primary artist or a featured-only performer/combination. Reviewed server contracts do not distinguish those roles. AlbumCount==0 is insufficient, and nil remains unknown.

current_0_7_review.current_policy: Library, artist Search and alphabetical artist pages share the AlbumArtists identity set. Primary standalone-only credits absent from that set may be omitted. Missing counts remain unknown; zero album counts are not proof of standalone status. Equal names do not merge distinct provider IDs.

provider_review.finding: GetPersons accepts personTypes/excludePersonTypes and bounded paging; no trustworthy primary-standalone versus featured-only predicate is established by those role filters.
Standard music handling assigns AlbumArtist to album-artist tags and Artist to every performer; this path supplies no primary-versus-featured distinction.
GetArtists and GetAlbumArtists remain implemented compatibility endpoints marked obsolete in favor of GetPersons. That replacement does not itself resolve the missing semantic distinction.

request_budget.scope: Static shared adapter contract, not measured latency, UI-wide total traffic or live-server acceptance. Authentication, artwork and unrelated catalog requests are outside these artist-query counts.
request_budget.cold_library_page: One GET /Artists/AlbumArtists per requested page, limit 50, provider-relative startIndex, SortName ascending, user and selected-library scope; no per-artist classification requests.
request_budget.artist_search_page: One GET /Artists/AlbumArtists per nonempty requested search page, trimmed searchTerm and limit 1...50. Blank query or invalid page input sends no request.
request_budget.warm_repeated_adapter_call: The adapter does not memoize artist pages: one repeated uncached Library/Search page call still makes one bounded GET. A caller using an existing valid page cache can avoid the adapter request; a universal zero-request warm result is not claimed.
request_budget.alphabet_page: One bounded artist page after capability verification. The account-shared capability check uses two one-row probe requests once while its verified result is retained; later verified pages do not repeat the probe. No whole-catalog walk is added.
request_budget.failure: A failed artist page does not retry or scan automatically. A later separately requested page/read remains independent.
request_budget.retention: Existing account-owned catalog page cache remains unchanged: 32 pages, 200 items per page, 256 KiB per entry and 2 MiB total. No standalone artist index or cache is introduced.
